fields.summary_ko.0: Seagate Technology Holdings plc (STX) declined 24.1% over the past month but reported fiscal Q1 revenue up 61% ($4.23B) and non-GAAP EPS of $7.68 (versus $2.61 prior year) showing strong results.
fields.summary_ko.1: Data center revenue represents 81% of mix, sequential shipments reached 198 exabytes (up 24%), with current 12-month forward P/E of 13.97x commanding premium versus industry average of 9.41x.
